requirement R1 One output line per input, in order: `signature <id> <r> <s>`, in lowercase hex
requirement R2 Both curves work: P-256 and P-384 each use their own p, a, G and n
requirement R3 Every nonce k works, including k = 1, k = 2, k = n - 1, and a large random k, so the answer must come from double-and-add, not a loop that runs k times

requirement R5 The hash z can be any value in range, including 0 and n - 1
